title: Yellow Crumbly Middle Eastern Emmentaler Cheese Flatbread
description: A spicy and crumbly flatbread featuring Emmentaler cheese, perfect for a light Middle Eastern-inspired snack. This recipe is onion and garlic free, making it suitable for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, salt, sugar, and grated Emmentaler cheese.
Gradually add the warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a thin circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Brush the dough with olive oil and sprinkle with paprika and cayenne pepper.
Place the flatbread on a wooden board and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until it is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
